name: Jeff Bezos
title: The Bookseller Who Reached for Space
subtitle: From a breakfast shift at McDonald's to a garage near Seattle, the everything store and a rocket company: how Jeff Bezos thinks, bets and sometimes gets it wrong.
hook: In 2013, a deep-sea team led by Jeff Bezos lifted the wreckage of Apollo rocket engines from more than ==14,000 feet== under the Atlantic. Months later, conservators cleaning off the corrosion found a serial number, 2044. It matched Engine No. 5 from **Apollo 11**, the Moon launch Bezos had watched on TV when he was five years old.

glance.label: Grew up
glance.value: Raised by his mother, still a teenager when he was born, and his Cuban-born stepfather Mike Bezos; summers on his grandfather's 25,000-acre ranch in Cotulla, Texas; valedictorian of his Miami high school

glance.label: Education
glance.value: Princeton University, degree in electrical engineering and computer science (1986)

glance.label: First job
glance.value: Breakfast-shift line cook at a Miami McDonald's, aged 16

glance.label: Before Amazon
glance.value: Senior vice president at D. E. Shaw, a New York firm that used computers to invest in the stock market

glance.label: First company (age)
glance.value: Amazon, incorporated 5 July 1994 when he was 30 and run from a garage near Seattle; the website opened on 16 July 1995

glance.label: Main role today
glance.value: Executive Chair of Amazon since July 2021 (CEO before that); owns about 8% of Amazon, plus Blue Origin and The Washington Post (bought in 2013 for $250 million)

glance.label: Net worth
glance.value: $373.9 billion, #2 in the world (Forbes real-time estimate, 29 October 2026); source: Amazon, self-made

glance.label: Family (public basics)
glance.value: Four children with MacKenzie Scott, divorced in 2019 after 25 years of marriage; married Lauren Sánchez in Venice on 27 June 2025

glance.label: Lives in
glance.value: Miami, Florida, USA (moved from Seattle in 2023)

contact.howToReach: Jeff Bezos stopped running Amazon day to day in 2021, so no route reaches him personally, but some doors into his world are real. If you are an Amazon customer with a genuine problem, jeff@amazon.com is the one address he made public himself; he has said he still sees many of those emails, and he is famous for forwarding some to the right team with a single "?" added, so send one short, specific message with your order number and the fix you want. Journalists should use the press emails of Amazon, the Bezos Earth Fund or Bezos Academy, and shareholders should use Amazon Investor Relations; none of these inboxes are for startup pitches, job requests or fan mail. The Day 1 Families Fund says expert advisors help select its grantees and lists no public application form, so a cold request for money will not work. The Bezos Family Foundation, created by his parents, warns that the "Jeff Bezos Families Relief Fund" promising cash to random people is a scam: never pay, or share personal details with, anyone offering Bezos money.

factCheck.method: Front matter and contact card built only from primary or established sources: Amazon's FY2025 10-K and SEC EDGAR (address, phone, role), Amazon's own IR and press-center contact pages, the official sites of Bezos Expeditions, Bezos Earth Fund, Bezos Academy, Bezos Day One Fund, the 10,000 Year Clock and the Bezos Family Foundation (emails read from the live pages, including Cloudflare-obfuscated addresses decoded from the page source), the Academy of Achievement profile and 2001 interview, Forbes' real-time profile (net worth as of 29 Oct 2026), and wire/press reports (Reuters, AP, CNN, CNBC, ABC, Fortune, The Washington Post). Social accounts are listed only when linked from an official site or shown as verified on the platform. Photos come from Wikimedia Commons, with author and licence read from the Commons API (extmetadata); thumbnails are 960px on upload.wikimedia.org (smaller originals used as-is). Personal phone numbers, guessed emails and home addresses were excluded; the Bellevue garage caption omits the street address. Blue Origin's own website blocked automated access (rate limit and security check), so no Blue Origin email, phone or street address is listed; its website and accounts are cited from Bezos Expeditions, LinkedIn and verified Instagram. Some pages (Princeton, CNBC) blocked direct fetching and were confirmed via search-engine extracts.

disputed.note: Forbes' profile (viewed 29 Oct 2026) still lists him as 'Engaged', but ABC News/AP reported that Bezos and Lauren Sánchez married in Venice on 27 June 2025, and the Bezos Earth Fund now calls her Lauren Sánchez Bezos. We use 'married'.

Forbes says Amazon started 'out of his Seattle garage'. The house and garage were in Bellevue, a city next to Seattle (Wikimedia Commons description citing GeekWire). We say 'a garage near Seattle' or Bellevue.
Amazon's 10-K says he served as CEO 'from May 1996 until July 2021', although he founded and ran the company from 1994. We only state that he was CEO until July 2021.
Secondary sources often say 'summa cum laude' and 'Phi Beta Kappa'; Princeton's own news office describes graduation with highest honours in 1986. We state only the degree and year.
The latest direct confirmation we found is CNBC's 2020 report quoting Bezos; we found no 2025-2026 confirmation, so the channel carries that caveat.
